1.text: Imigani ya Salomo mwene Dawidi, umwami w'Abisirayeli.

2.text: Ni iyo kumenyesha ubwenge n'ibibwirizwa,Ni iyo gusobanura amagambo y'ubuhanga.

3.text: Ni yo ihesha ubwenge bw'imigenzereze,No gukiranuka no gutunganya no kutabera.

4.text: Ni yo iha umuswa kujijuka,N'umusore ikamuha kumenya no kugira amakenga,

5.text: Kugira ngo umunyabwenge atege amatwi yunguke ubwenge,Kandi umuhanga agere ku migambi itunganye.

6.text: Amenye gusobanura imigani n'amarenga,Kandi n'amagambo n'ibisakuzo by'abanyabwenge.

7.text: Kūbaha Uwiteka ni ishingiro ryo kumenya,Ariko umupfapfa ahinyura ubwenge n'ibibwiriza.

8.text: Mwana wanjye, jya wumva icyo so akwigisha,Kandi we kureka icyo nyoko agutegeka.

9.text: Bizakubera imitamirizo y'imbabazi ku mutwe,N'imikufi mu ijosi.

11.text: Nibavuga bati “Ngwino tujyane,Twubikirire kuvusha amaraso,Ducire ibico abatariho urubanza tubahore ubusa,

12.text: Tubamire bunguri ari bazima nk'uko imva imira abantu,Ndetse ari bataraga nk'abamanuka bajya muri rwa rwobo,

13.text: Tuzabona ibintu byiza byinshi,Kandi tuzuzuza amazu yacu iminyago,

14.text: Uzakubira hamwe natwe,Twese tuzagire uruhago rumwe.”

15.text: Mwana wanjye, ntukajyane na bo,Urinde ibirenge byawe kujya mu nzira yabo,

16.text: Kuko ibirenge byabo byirukira gukora ibibi,Kandi bihutira kuvusha amaraso.

17.text: Gutega umutego ikiguruka kiwureba,Ni ukurushywa n'ubusa.

18.text: Amaraso bubikira ni ayabo,Ubwabo bugingo ni bwo bacira ibico.

19.text: Uko ni ko inzira z'urarikira indamu wese zimeze,Iryo rari ryica bene ryo.

20.text: Bwenge arangururira mu nzira,Yumvikanisha ijwi rye mu miharuro,

21.text: Aterera hejuru mu mahuriro yo mu marembo,Mu mudugudu ni ho yumvikanishirizamo amagambo ye ngo:

22.text: “Yemwe mwa baswa mwe, muzakunda ubuswa mugeze ryari?Namwe bakobanyi, muzageza ryari kwishimira ubukobanyi,N'abapfu mukanga kumenya ubwenge?

23.text: Nimuhindurwe n'imiburo yanjye,Dore nzabasukaho umwuka wanjye,Nzabamenyesha amagambo yanjye.

25.text: Ahubwo mwahinyuye inama zanjye zose,No kubacyaha kwanjye ntimubyitaho.

26.text: Nuko nanjye rero nzabakina ku mubyimba mwagize ibyago,Nzabaseka icyo mwatinyaga kibagezeho.

27.text: Igihe muzatungurwa n'ubwoba nk'umugaru,Ibyago byanyu bikaza nka serwakira,Igihe umubabaro n'uburibwe bizabageraho.

29.text: Kuko banze kumenya,Kandi ntibahisemo kūbaha Uwiteka.

30.text: Ntibemeye inama zanjye,Bahinyuye guhana kwanjye kose.

31.text: Ni cyo gituma bazarya ibiva mu ngeso zabo,Kandi bazahazwa n'imigambi yabo.

32.text: Ubuhemu bw'abaswa buzabicisha,Kandi kugubwa neza kw'abapfu kuzabarimbura.

33.text: Ariko unyumvira wese azaba amahoro,Adendeze kandi atikanga ikibi.”
